meta.name: Deadlock Test
meta.notes: Solvable under correct play (pick the two red buckets at [0,5] and [0,6]); reaches rules-doc deadlock under bad play. Bad sequence: pick [0,0] through [0,4] — buffer fills with 5 blue buckets but field has only red slices, so no consumption occurs and the buffer cannot free a slot. With no remaining legal actions (buffer full), the episode terminates as a deadlock-lose. The random agent hits deadlock on seeds where it picks enough blues before reds.
